title: A verified commit whose deploy failed once is served after a retry, without restarting the watch
description: The running deploy watch meets a one-off build failure and then a one-off restart failure on a verified commit. It tries the commit again after a short backoff, and /healthz reports the verified commit with the failed step cleared, from the same watch process.

steps.name: Fail a deploy once, let the running watch retry it, and verify /healthz serves the verified commit
